notes: All tuning for the ring-escape format lives here, never in code. Distances are px in the 1080x1920 frame, angles in degrees, time in seconds. Re-run `python escape/engine.py --survey 100` after editing to see how durations and per-ring timings move.

rings.notes: Per-ring lists, inner ring first; their length is the ring count. The difficulty curve is physical: wide fast gaps break at once, narrow slow ones hold. Negative spin turns the other way. spiral_deg offsets each ring's gap from the one inside it, which paces the hook (near 0 the gaps line up and the ball flies through several at once).

shape.notes: What engine.score() rewards. Rings [0, hook_rings) are the hook, the last boss_rings are the boss, the rest are the middle.
